_meta.description: Project type → Florida DBPR occupation codes for Plan + Cost Studio matching. primary order = preference (first is best fit). secondary expands only when local primary is empty. Prefer fewer strong specialty matches over broad GC fill.
_meta.audit: 2026-08 matching quality review: residential remodels prefer CRC/CBC before CGC; roofing specialty-only (no CGC secondary); bathroom residential + plumbing before commercial CBC/CGC.

kitchen_remodel.label: Kitchen Remodel
kitchen_remodel.notes: Home kitchens: prefer residential (CRC) and building (CBC) contractors who typically coordinate multi-trade remodels. CGC remains valid for larger scopes but ranks after residential/building so commercial-scale GCs do not dominate. Plumbing (CFC) only if no local GC-class matches.

bathroom_remodel.label: Bathroom Remodel
bathroom_remodel.notes: Full baths usually need residential remodel coordination (CRC) and/or plumbing specialty (CFC). CBC for building-level scopes. CGC only when local primary classes are empty — avoids flooding baths with unrelated general contractors.

full_home_renovation.label: Full Home Renovation
full_home_renovation.notes: Whole-home residential work: CRC first, then CBC, then CGC. No specialty-only fill.

addition.label: Addition / Extension
addition.notes: Structural additions: residential/building/general authority. CRC preferred for typical home additions.

basement_finish.label: Basement / Lower-Level Finish
basement_finish.notes: Uncommon in FL; same residential-first GC classes as interior renovations.

roofing.label: Roofing
roofing.notes: Roofing specialty only (certified CCC, registered RC). RR is registered residential, not roofing. Do not fall back to CGC — a general contractor is not a substitute roofing match for homeowners. Thin areas expand statewide within CCC/RC only.

siding_exterior.label: Siding / Exterior
siding_exterior.notes: Building/residential/general for envelope re-clad. Specialty structure (SCC) only when local primary is empty.

deck_outdoor.label: Deck / Outdoor Living
deck_outdoor.notes: Outdoor structures often under building/residential/GC. SCC only when local primary is empty (screen enclosures / specialty structures).

custom_home_rebuild.label: New Custom Home / Knockdown Rebuild
custom_home_rebuild.notes: New construction / major rebuild: CGC and CBC preferred; CRC included for residential-scale rebuilds. No secondary specialties.

general_contracting.label: Other / General Contracting
general_contracting.notes: Catch-all homeowner GC work: residential-first ranking so results feel home-project appropriate rather than commercial CGC-heavy.
